title: Children of Time
author: Adrian Tchaikovsky
summary: The last humans flee a dying Earth in an ark ship in search of a new home, while on a distant planet a different species slowly evolves intelligence. The two stories run in parallel across thousands of years.
readIf: you like ambitious science fiction that makes you root for an alien civilisation.
skipIf: you are afraid of spiders, since a lot of the book is told from their point of view.

pairings.reason: Another big, slow-building story about the clash and contact of civilisations.
A friendlier, quicker story that also builds a surprising bond across species.
